capabilities: duplicate a file from the tab header context menu
duplicate a file from the file explorer context menu
create a -copy file next to the original with the same content
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README's publishing section is developer-facing release instructions rather than user documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to duplicate a file from the tab header or file explorer context menu.
summary: File duplication utility that adds a Duplicate file option to tab and file-explorer context menus, creating a -copy file next to the original.
